notes.records: rows in texts (one per source listing)
notes.periods/languages tablets: distinct tablets carrying that label in at least one source; a tablet can carry labels from several sources

queries.with_text: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(canonical_id,id)) FROM texts WHERE has_atf=1
queries.human_en: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT canonical_id) FROM translations WHERE lang='en' AND author_type='human'
queries.machine_en: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT canonical_id) FROM translations WHERE lang='en' AND author_type='model'
queries.any_en: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT canonical_id) FROM translations WHERE lang='en'
queries.text_no_en: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(canonical_id,id) c FROM texts GROUP BY c HAVING MAX(has_atf)=1) WHERE c NOT IN (SELECT canonical_id FROM translations WHERE lang='en' AND canonical_id IS NOT NULL)
queries.with_coords: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(canonical_id,id)) FROM texts WHERE lat IS NOT NULL
queries.place_names: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT provenience) FROM texts WHERE lat IS NOT NULL
queries.mapped: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(canonical_id,id)) FROM texts WHERE usable_site(provenience,lat,lon)=1
queries.map_points: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT printf('%.3f,%.3f',lat,lon)) FROM texts WHERE usable_site(provenience,lat,lon)=1
